g.text: Physics hints and benchmark completion at High effort

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start

g.text: 13 frozen tasks, three repeats per condition. 351 observations: 313 local and 38 historical controls.

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Frontiers use only 4 of 9 settings with complete costs. Missing or uncertain costs exclude the other 5.

text.style: font-size: 15px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Above bars: completed passes out of 39. Below zero: execution errors. Errors do not establish physics failures.

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Luna uses historical controls with different CLI version, date and concurrency. Local scheduling changed from 3 to 6 trials sharing 8 CPUs.

text.style: font-size: 14px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start

g.text: These are descriptive comparisons. Seven Prime observations retain uncertain charges; spending reserves are not confirmed costs.
